sentence.rungUp: {sym} must trade at {spot} or higher by {when} ({move}) for {name} to sell {qty} at {price} ({pnl}).
sentence.rungDown: {sym} must trade at {spot} or lower by {when} ({move}) for {name} to sell {qty} at {price} ({pnl}).
sentence.rungPast: {name} sells {qty} at {price} ({pnl}) as soon as the contract gets there: the stock is already on the right side.
sentence.unreachable: {name} at {price} can't be reached before expiry at any stock price.
sentence.breakevenUp: Breakeven: {sym} at {spot} or higher by {when} ({move}). Below that the time decay wins.
sentence.breakevenDown: Breakeven: {sym} at {spot} or lower by {when} ({move}). Above that the time decay wins.
sentence.stopUp: If {sym} falls to {now} right now, the stop sells everything for {pnl}.
sentence.stopDown: If {sym} rises to {now} right now, the stop sells everything for {pnl}.
sentence.decayUp: Time decay alone reaches the stop by the exit time unless {sym} rises above {exit}.
sentence.decayDown: Time decay alone reaches the stop by the exit time unless {sym} falls below {exit}.
sentence.stopOdds: Odds the stop is hit first: {pct}.
sentence.calamity: Worst case {pnl} if the stop never fills (a gap, a halt, no bid).
sentence.noVol: No volatility data: levels shown at expiry only. Refresh the market.

finder.title: The finder
finder.on: Open paper plays from the news with nobody at the keyboard
finder.moveMustAgree: Skip a story when the stock is moving against its angle
finder.note: Every five minutes of the stock session the finder reads the stories board. A loud, well-sourced story that leans one way on a stock gets an option play: calls when bullish, puts when bearish. A found play is paper traded only when it passes every blocking rule; otherwise it waits as a draft.

rulesEditor.resetConfirm: Replace the whole rulebook with the DOGS defaults?

exits_required.label: Exits before entry
exits_required.about: No play runs without ladder exits, a runner plan, a stop and every failsafe: time, sideways, glitch and calamity.

crowd_evidence.label: Other money is in it
crowd_evidence.about: Proof other traders are in the trade: open interest, a volume surge, flow, on-chain activity, verified news or trader signals.

news_trust.label: News must earn trust
news_trust.about: Headlines with too few sources or too little verified history are ignored. AI-found news waits for a person to verify it.

volume_first.label: Follow the whales
volume_first.about: Volume is the first input: the stock against its average and the contract's own trading today.

liquidity.label: A way out
liquidity.about: A tight spread and enough open interest that a sell order has a buyer.

lotto_guard.label: No penny lottery tickets
lotto_guard.about: No contracts under a minimum premium or far out of the money. They often have no bid.

reward_risk.label: Reward pays for risk
reward_risk.about: Max profit must be a multiple of the planned loss at the stop.

time_left.label: Time left
time_left.about: Enough days to expiry, and a time exit before the last days of decay.

event_crush.label: Event crush
event_crush.about: Warns when earnings land before expiry: implied volatility collapses after the report.

opening_wait.label: Let the open settle
opening_wait.about: No entries in the opening rush or the last minutes before the close.

no_chase.label: Don't chase the gap
no_chase.about: Warns when the stock already moved the play's way today. The move may be spent.

bankroll_risk.label: Bankroll guard
bankroll_risk.about: Caps the share of the bankroll lost at the stop and in the worst case.

odds_floor.label: Odds floor
odds_floor.about: The DOGS odds of the first exit must clear a floor.

positive_edge.label: Positive edge
positive_edge.about: The scenarios weighted by the market's odds should not lose money on average.

theme_cap.label: One headline, one bet
theme_cap.about: Caps how many armed plays share a theme. AAL, DAL and UAL on one outage are one bet.

max_open.label: Open play cap
max_open.about: Caps how many plays are armed at once.

fresh_data.label: Fresh data
fresh_data.about: Never arm on a stale market snapshot.

limit_entry.label: Pay the middle
limit_entry.about: Entry must be a limit near the mid, not the ask.

cooldown.label: No revenge trades
cooldown.about: Waits after a losing close on the same symbol.

size_impact.label: A size the market can take
size_impact.about: Caps the order as a share of today's volume and open interest, so the fill and the exit are real.

stop_ladder.label: The stop climbs
stop_ladder.about: After exit 1 the stop moves to the entry; after exit 2, to exit 1. A green trade never turns red.

spine.decayMarker: Stop by the exit: time decay alone

demo.hint: Recorded {when} · changes stay on this page
demo.gone: That play is no longer on this page. Reload to bring the recording back.
demo.unknownLink: The demo reads its recorded plays only. Try {example}.

record.stopsByRule: Stop-losses 2 and 3 come from the "stop climbs" rule: the entry after exit 1, then exit 1 after exit 2.
record.noCurve: No prices for this play yet.

sources.contract: Replayed over the contract's own traded prices, one candle a day.
sources.model: Replayed over prices worked out from the stock's candles at the planned volatility.

record.caution: When one candle touched both the stop and an exit, the stop is counted first. Fills are assumed at the stop and exit prices; a thin contract may not give them.
record.demoOnly: The demo holds one recorded backtest per play.

wrong.stop: The price fell to the stop-loss, and everything left was sold there.
wrong.time: The time exit came before any exit paid for the play.
wrong.time stop: It went sideways too long and the sideways exit closed it.
wrong.source exit: The source called its own exit while the play was down.
wrong.void: There was never a quote to close it at, so it was dropped unscored.

orders.wrongRules: It was let through these blocking rules as a paper trade: {rules}.
orders.wrongSlip: It lost {lost} against a planned {planned}: the sale filled below the stop, at the bid.
